notes.claim: The phasors for a resistor and a reactance are 90 degrees apart, so the series impedance comes from Pythagoras' law.
Voltages 90 degrees apart do not add arithmetically: a 6 V source and an 8 V source at 90 degrees give 10 V.
Inductive reactance is X_L = 2πfL, so a measured reactance at a known frequency gives the inductance.

sources.title: Lessons In Electric Circuits -- Volume II (AC) - Chapter 3
sources.quote: Inductive reactance can be calculated using this formula: X L = 2πfL
